name: Los Angeles Times editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Los Angeles Times Lean Left (-2.00; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026) and Ad Fontes rates it Skews Left (-6.21). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: Los Angeles Daily News / Southern California News Group editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Los Angeles Daily News Center (independent review, initial rating July 2020; low or initial confidence as of Sept. 2026). Its editorials come from the Southern California News Group board it shares with the OC Register, whose news AllSides rates Lean Right.

name: Orange County Register editorial board (same board as the Daily News)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Orange County Register Lean Right (2.00; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). One Southern California News Group board writes the editorials for the Register, the LA Daily News and nine sister papers.

name: League of Women Voters of Greater Los Angeles
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter; its page calls the League 'a nonpartisan political organization encouraging informed and active participation in government' (https://my.lwv.org/california/greater-los-angeles/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: LA Forward (LA Forward Action Fund voter guide)
lean_basis: Self-described progressive group; its guide is titled 'Los Angeles Progressive Voter Guide' (https://laforwardguide.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Thrive LA
lean_basis: Describes itself as 'a pragmatic, nonpartisan voter guide' (https://www.thrivelosangeles.org/voter-guide), with no stated ideological mission. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Knock LA
lean_basis: Self-described left publication: 'We are dedicated to giving a voice to the left and uplifting marginalized communities' (https://knock-la.com/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Los Angeles County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county Democratic Party organization. Its candidates page lists its Nov 2026 candidate endorsements and a table of positions on statewide and local measures (read Oct 17, 2026).

name: Republican Party of Los Angeles County
lean_basis: Official county Republican Party organization. Its Nov 3, 2026 candidate picks and its positions on LA city and county measures are published in an address-lookup tool linked from lagop.org (read Oct 17, 2026). It marks some candidate picks as recommended rather than formally endorsed.

name: Republican Party of Orange County
lean_basis: Official county Republican Party organization. No 2026 endorsement list was found on its website on Oct 17, 2026; positions below come from LAist and candidate pages.

name: Los Angeles County Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Federation of about 300 unions in LA County that says 'We empower workers to organize and take collective action to win better wages and respect in the workplace' (https://thelafed.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Los Angeles Area Chamber of Commerce (L.A. Jobs PAC)
lean_basis: Regional chamber of commerce that calls itself 'a bold advocate for business' (https://lachamber.com/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Abundant Housing LA
lean_basis: Pro-housing group that says more homes near transit are needed to 'lower housing costs, solve our climate crisis, and avoid displacement' (https://www.abundanthousingla.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Streets For All
lean_basis: Safe-streets and transit group that says 'we believe our air doesn’t have to be polluted' (https://www.streetsforall.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Los Angeles League of Conservation Voters
lean_basis: Environmental group that calls itself 'the only environmental Political Action Committee (PAC) in Los Angeles County' (https://lalcv.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Los Angeles Police Protective League
lean_basis: Police union whose motto, 'Protecting Those Who Protect Others' (https://lapd.com/), uses no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Association for Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs
lean_basis: Deputies' union formed, in its words, 'to ensure that the rights of future Deputy Sheriffs would be protected' (https://www.alads.org/), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Official measure campaigns (Yes/No committees and argument authors)
lean_basis: Not a single source: each row lists the official sponsor or opponent of that measure as printed in the city pamphlet or filed with the county. Included so each measure shows who is actually campaigning for and against it.
